headline: Philippine Consumer Spending Growth Projected at 2.8% Through 2027
summary: BMI projected Philippine household spending will grow by 2.8% in 2027 as elevated debt and high borrowing costs linger.
why: Household consumption accounts for over 70% of the Philippines' GDP.

impacts.name: Philippines
impacts.why: Consumer spending growth rate is expected to remain constrained near 2.8%.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
